notes: load changed from crashing (~|(%load-type-fail !!)) to ~&(%ames-reset ..^$) when the old vase's type does not nest: all Ames state is dropped and the vane restarts from bunt. A whole-state discard on type mismatch is a policy choice, so j. When the type does nest the old noun is kept as is (boot then rebuilds crypto cores, which predates this commit).
load takes ?(fort furt). %0 becomes [%1 gad hop ~ ton zac], so a bad=(set ship) blocklist for |nuke is added with an empty default.
[%0 *] becomes [%1 gad hop bad ton zac ~]. The new ten field holds lane-change (%tend/%rove) subscriber ducts, empty by default.

Adds veb=veb-all-off (a constant). For known peers, qos %unborn gains a timestamp, [%unborn now]. That value is the event time, not a constant, so the step is near derive. The code is the same in the original 35596ca7de version.
veb moves into a new record, bug=[veb ships=~], so per-ship tracing (%sift) can be added. The structural move is coded as reshape, as for 11->12. ships is an empty add.

The adult state does not change ([%3 ames-state] becomes %4 with the same contents). queued-events-1-to-4 (05f0e47f68) drops queued larval %wegh calls (bare or %soft) because the task was removed for fusion. The queued work is discarded.

ops: in(peers: map(in(snd: map(in(packet-pump-state: in(metrics: in(num-live: compute)))))))
notes: The types are the same (ames-state-4 = ames-state-5). num-live is recomputed as ~(wyt in live), per 5ac70ec974 'reset num-live to actual number of live packets', so it fixes a counter that had drifted.

Each known peer gains a rift, read from Jael by a %j /rift scry. Comets (%pawn) are hardcoded to 0 because Jael has no comet data (02806f63a1). That is a rank-based special case, but comets cannot breach, so it is not coded j.
Known peers gain three empty sets (closing, corked, krocs) for flow closing.
Adds corks=*(set wire). molt also sets a %b %wait /recork timer for one day later ('init daily recork timer').
The veb flag tuple gains one bit, %.n (bug-9 to bug-12). %kroc is introduced, and the queued-event type changes only by allowing a new task.

ops: add(rift); read; in(crypto-core: compute); in(bug: in(veb: add)); in(peers: map(add(keens)))
notes: Our own rift is read from Jael (%j scry). The crypto core is rebuilt as acru-25 from the secret key (nol:nu), which is near re-encode because the core's type changed. veb gains a bit. Aliens' heeds and known peers' corked gain an empty keens slot for remote scry (%keen).
wan changes from a deque of wants to an ordered map ((on @ud want) lte) keyed by fragment number fra (ded0b75914). The data are kept and the container changes.

The types are the same. If cong is the bunt [0 0] it becomes [5 100.000], otherwise it is kept (19f5946e72 'only reinitialize congestion if bunted'). It fixes values that an earlier migration left bunted. The one-entry table is coded convert.

ops: in(cong: wrap); add(dead); in(dead: in(cork: compute)); in(peers: map(in(snd: map(in(metrics: remove(num-live)))), in(keens: map(in(metrics: remove(num-live)))), in(rcv: map(in(nax: filter)))))
notes: The dead-flow timers are stored in state: dead=[flow/~ cork/`[/ames /recork now+1d]] (45924f7571). num-live is dropped from pump and keen metrics. remove-outbound-naxplanations filters nax entries that are already done (2c854d1285 'remove space leak'), which is repair. molt reads Behn's /debug/timers by scry and sets a recork timer if none exists. Ambiguous among add, discard and repair.

Tag bump only (-.u.cached-state %18). molt sends %j %public-keys for our own ship ('fetching our public keys'). Intent is repair (1b0e47a6a3 'do not ignore our peer-state'), but state is not changed. Coded like 26->27.
veb gains a bit, %.n. molt also gives %saxo (the sponsorship chain from get-sponsors) on the unix duct to start informal %ping.
%heed and %jilt are removed (95caa5b5fe): heeds is dropped from alien and known peer states, and event-20-to-last drops queued %heed and %jilt calls from the larval queue.
dead gains rots/`[/ames /routes now+retry-timer]. molt sets the matching %b %wait /routes timer ('start dead /routes timer').

ops: in(crypto-core: hoist(priv)); remove(crypto-core); rename(chain->server-chain); in(dead: add(chum)); add(chums); add(core)
notes: Directed Messaging (mesa) scaffolding. The crypto core is replaced by the raw private key, sec:ex. chain becomes server-chain. An empty chums map is added, plus a constant mode flag core=%ames (could be coded convert) and a chum dead timer. molt sets the /mesa/retry timer. Mixes reshape, add and derive (priv is extracted from the core).

ops: in(peers: map(in(keens: map-keys(compute)), in(keens: map(in(listeners: container, add(ints)))), in(chain: add(tip), compute))); in(chums: map(in(pit: map(in(for: container, add(ints)))), in(client-chain: add(tip), compute)))
notes: Adds a reverse .pit lookup map, tip: user path to [duct ames-path]. It is computed by decrypting existing encrypted scry paths (%shut with chain keys, %chum with the symmetric key, decrypt-path for mesa). Keen and peek ducts are retagged with ints %tune or %sage. Paths that do not parse are skipped with a print (a small filter).
A known chum's lane becomes `[hop=1 lane]`, a constant default.

ops: in(peers: map(in(tip: add(halt)))); in(chums: map(in(flows: map(add(halt)))))
notes: 'add halted flows' (0d7899855e): ship-state gains halt=~ (set bone). Each mesa flow is rebuilt from a bunt flow-state, copying closing, line, snd and rcv, so the only new datum is halt=%.n.

ops: in(priv: compute); in(peers: map(in(azimuth-state: in(pass: compute)))); in(chums: map(in(azimuth-state: in(pass: compute))))
notes: 'change key format'. priv becomes [saf priv pub], computed by nol:nu:cric. Each peer's pass becomes [ded:ex:(com pass) pass], the derived key plus the original. No outside reads.
